# Orofacial Therapeutics

> Medical device company specializing in TMJ/TMD diagnosis, treatment protocols, and clinical solutions for jaw pain, bruxism, and orofacial disorders.

Founded by Ann McCulloch and Dr. Bradley Eli (DMD, MS), Orofacial Therapeutics develops evidence-based clinical protocols and dental appliances for managing temporomandibular disorders and related orofacial pain conditions. The company serves dental professionals and healthcare providers with comprehensive treatment strategies and medical devices.

## Key Topics

- TMJ/TMD disorders
- Orofacial pain management
- JAMSS protocol
- Jaw pain treatment
- Bruxism treatment
- Clinical protocols
- Dental appliances
- QuickSplint
- S.A.F.E. protocol
- Headache management
- Temporomandibular joint
- Medical devices
- Dental professionals
- Patient recovery
- Chronic pain management

## Products & Solutions

- [JAMSS - Professional Solutions for Jaw Pain and Strain](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/jamss): JAMSS product overview for jaw joint and muscle sprain/strain treatment.
- [Our Brands - Orofacial Therapeutics](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/our-brands): Product portfolio including QuickSplint and Speed2Treat dental appliances.

## Clinical Protocols & Guidelines

- [Clinical Protocols - Orofacial Therapeutics](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/jamss/protocols): Clinical protocols for TMD and bruxism management with early intervention guidelines.
- [JAMSS Protocol Instructions for Healthcare Professionals](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/jamss/protocols/jamss-protocol-instructions): JAMSS protocol instructions for managing acute jaw joint and muscle sprain/strain.
- [S.A.F.E. Protocol Instructions - Orofacial Therapeutics](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/jamss/protocols/s-a-f-e-protocol-instructions): S.A.F.E. protocol to prevent jaw injury during dental procedures.
- [Bruxism Treatment Strategies - Orofacial Therapeutics](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/bruxism-treatment-strategies): Treatment strategies for bruxism and teeth grinding with clinical assessment.

- [Treating headaches Safely During Pregnancy Without Drugs](https://www.orofacialtherapeutics.com/headache-tmd-studies/treating-headaches-during-pregnancy-without-drugs): Drug-free headache treatment strategies during pregnancy related to jaw pain.
